search_intelligence.note: Search-demand repoint (owner approved 11 Oct 2026). validate_site_hygiene.js reads this block: files present and wired, Search Console truth fresh and consistent, every target measured, the freeze read by the release lane, the ranked-links layer installed.

zero_paid_llm.note: Owner policy 11 Oct 2026: "nothing should be paid ... cut the probes and make them free." validate_site_hygiene.js runs scripts/lib/zero_paid_llm_check.js against this block (scheduled workflows reach no model outside the free router; config/llm_routing.json holds only $0 models, max_cost_usd 0, stale snapshot = warning; probe workflows dispatch-only behind confirm_paid) and replays its hostile fixtures every run. Folded into the site-hygiene blocker so the 40-blocker cap holds. See docs/cost/zero-paid-llm.md.

build_result_cache.note: Search Readiness h5: the merge gate builds the site ONCE per commit instead of once per job. validate_site_hygiene.js runs scripts/lib/build_cache_contract_check.js against this block (the lane builds through the wrapper; the wrapper still refuses a store inside the checkout and an entry it cannot read back complete; every workflow that reaches the wrapper (discovered from .github/workflows, not listed) sets BUILD_CACHE_DIR outside the checkout and caches that same path; the wall-clock-stamped generated ledgers stay out of the hashed input surface) and replays its hostile fixtures every run. Folded into the site-hygiene blocker so the 40-blocker cap holds, exactly as zero_paid_llm was. The byte-identity proof over the cache is build-result-cache-integrity, which is audit-only because four lane stages after site-build write into data/ and move the input hash.

github_write_retry.note: 30 Oct 2026: a GitHub HTTP 500 on a bare `gh workflow run` left Velocity Content Release red after it pushed (run 41069439670), and a 500 on POST /issues left CI Health Red Recovery red (run 41071294097). validate_site_hygiene.js runs scripts/lib/github_write_retry_check.js (no bare gh workflow run / gh issue write on any discovered workflow; dispatches go through scripts/ci/dispatch_workflow.js; the alert re-reads inside each retried attempt so a landed-but-500 POST is never duplicated) plus its hostile fixtures, and runs scripts/tests/test_github_write_retry.js, requiring at least min_behaviour_pins passes.
